title: English Practice Quiz 0890
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the closest meaning of 'meticulous'.
questions.explanation: Meticulous means showing great attention to detail.

questions.question: The new procedure is intended to ___ delays.
questions.explanation: Mitigate means make something less severe.

questions.question: Choose the correct use of 'complement'.
options: The blue tie complements the suit.
The compliment is on the table.
questions.explanation: Complement means go well with or complete something.

questions.question: A 'feasible' plan is one that is:
options: practical and possible to carry out
questions.explanation: Feasible means capable of being done successfully.

questions.question: Choose the best word: The manager gave a ___ explanation supported by evidence.
'Obsolete' equipment is:
questions.explanation: Obsolete describes something outdated or no longer in use.

questions.question: Which word means 'to make something more efficient'?
questions.explanation: Streamline means simplify or improve efficiency.

questions.question: Choose the correct phrase.
questions.explanation: Principle means a fundamental rule or belief.

questions.question: Choose the sentence using 'discreet' correctly.
options: Please be discreet when discussing the confidential case.
The discreet of the report is high.
questions.explanation: Discreet means careful to avoid attracting attention or revealing information.
